A defined scope

Know what we
are building together.

Requirements, deliverables, and acceptance criteria are agreed for your project. The items below are topics to define during discovery, rather than a fixed package.

  • A review of the use case, data availability, and project constraints
  • Prototype requirements and an evaluation approach
  • Integration with agreed systems and information sources
  • Checks for answer quality, error handling, access, and human review
  • Deployment and support responsibilities defined in the project scope

Common questions

Before we begin.

Do we need to train our own AI model?

Not always. An existing model, retrieval from your documents, or a simpler automation may be sufficient. Discovery helps establish which approach fits the task.

Can you connect AI to our existing systems?

Integrations can be included when the systems provide suitable access. We review APIs, permissions, and data handling before agreeing to an implementation.

How do you measure whether an AI project works?

We agree on evaluation criteria before development. Depending on the task, these may include answer usefulness, classification quality, error rates, and the need for human review.
